precedence: Applicable external obligations must be identified by their owner. Within each concept, its canonical source-of-truth policy and validated contracts govern; accepted scoped decisions cannot silently weaken invariants. Current intent governs subordinate plans. Instructions route to those authorities. GFD is binding only through this accepted mapping; informative material, projections, caches and history cannot replace an effective authority. Unresolved conflicts suspend the affected change; neither recency nor similarity resolves precedence.

authorities.scope: Canonical source by concept and state mode
Source delivery lanes and this scoped adoption
Bounded source-agent work; routes to scoped authorities

sections.rationale: Personal agent-driven context and cumulative hats; project_owner reviews changed external or operational boundaries.
sections.responsibility: project_owner records changed project context and applicable duties.

sections.rationale: Use the explicit scoped precedence and authority map; unresolved conflicts pause the affected change, not every historical consultation.
sections.responsibility: project_owner resolves conflicts; technical_owner maintains canonical bindings.

sections.rationale: Objectives, non-goals, assumptions and acceptance criteria precede implementation; detection does not accept a proposed rule.
sections.responsibility: project_owner accepts intent changes; agents maintain scope and distinguish proposals.

sections.rationale: Use accepted ADRs or existing decision records for costly choices, with authority, date, status and replacement; avoid a record per trivial tool occurrence.
sections.responsibility: technical_owner records decisions; deciding authority accepts or supersedes them.

sections.rationale: Preserve concept-specific invariants and public contracts; process compliance never establishes product validity.
sections.responsibility: technical_owner owns contracts and identifies any required material evidence.

sections.rationale: Existing gate catalog owns automatic controls; manual risk, value, exceptions and costs remain claim-specific responsibilities.
sections.responsibility: technical_owner reviews control value and fallback; evidence_operator records observed costs.

sections.rationale: Use exact revision, method, environment and limits; retain PASS/FAIL/SKIP and explicit UNAVAILABLE evidence without converting CI telemetry into runtime state.
sections.responsibility: evidence_operator qualifies claims and preserves evidence; native evidence is never inferred from fixtures.

sections.rationale: Never attribute a product failure to an unexecuted product test. Separate execution, gate, proof, product judgement and failure layer in evidence; preserve causal references and assess claim-specific materiality. No general AOI schema conformance is claimed.
sections.responsibility: evidence_operator declares meaningful attempts and links correction validation; project_owner decides materiality and historical sidecars.

sections.rationale: Keep proposed, effective and superseded sources distinguishable; preserve earlier immutable references and assess changed claims before invalidating evidence.
sections.responsibility: data_owner preserves history; technical_owner identifies affected claims.

sections.rationale: Instructions route to stable authorities. L0 measures bytes and limitations; task-scoped complete units and native token promises remain later lots.
sections.responsibility: technical_owner reviews context debt and names consumer and task.

sections.rationale: Maintain one source per responsibility with reference checks; historical documents and generated summaries do not become canonical.
sections.responsibility: technical_owner maintains ownership, replacement and translation relationships.

sections.rationale: Agents keep bounded authorization and unchanged acceptance criteria; no invented authority, evidence, permissions or silent scope expansion.
sections.responsibility: project_owner authorizes scope; reviewers state actual independence and evidence limits.

sections.rationale: Report only measured, named-proxy or unknown costs; do not reconstruct model tokens or savings from memory.
sections.responsibility: evidence_operator records collection method; project_owner judges proportionality.

sections.rationale: Use the minimum audit profile sufficient for the question; reform requires owner instruction and a testable bounded change.
sections.responsibility: project_owner selects improvements; evidence_operator separates facts, inferences and unknowns.

sections.rationale: ADR-0010 and the executable catalog own delivery lanes. AIDN FAST is restricted to recognized non-normative/history docs; critical or public source changes remain ASSURED; emergency is an overlay. Client work modes are a separate axis.
sections.responsibility: release_authority owns emergency/publication scope; no agent self-declares emergency.

sections.rationale: This declaration pins method, scope, adaptations, omissions, owner and review triggers. Each client accepts its own policy; no full-conformance or certification claim follows.
sections.responsibility: project_owner accepts revisions and explicit omissions; retain superseded history.

omissions: No complete GFD conformance or product certification is claimed.
Addendum 0001 schemas, general attempt storage and retrospective migration are not adopted. Its evidence distinctions and materiality principles are adapted prospectively.
No universal 8 KiB context or model-token budget is adopted; native consumption and token evidence are unavailable.
Native Codex, external client, Windows and live deployment qualification require separate evidence.
Installed projects must accept their own declaration; source adoption is never inherited by install or detection.
No committees, separate-person approval or invented external duties are imposed on this personal project.
reviewTriggers: Contributors, users, deployment, criticality or external duties change.
A mapped contract, authority, control, method revision or acceptance rule changes materially.
Native or client evidence contradicts a recorded limit or obligation.
A control creates recurrent false blocks or measured maintenance/context cost.
